rca of the issue: Original user report ('cannot enter the lounge' via Entrar al Lounge) is NOT reproducible from the code alone — button correctly redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<encoded /dashboard>. When Emergent returns the correct email (bryanugalde290@gmail.com), backend issues a session_token cookie and /auth/me works. The most likely cause of Bryan's real-world failure is that Google returned a different account than expected (personal vs. corporate/alias) and the current 403 body — 'Acceso restringido. Este lounge privado es solo para Bryan.' — does NOT tell him which account was actually detected. Mitigation (already promised by E1 but NOT applied): append 'Detectamos: <email>' to the 403 detail so Bryan sees the exact account and can use 'Cambiar de cuenta Google'. That single string change closes the loop.
